_doc: The structural-scan lane (docs/TESTING_STANDARDS.md section 5.1). Pins for every scanner, the failure-registry sources the ast-grep rules are generated from, SkillSpector's targets and policy, and the per-rule promotion record. Read by tools/wall/quality.py; edited by hand only for promotions and policy -- version bumps go through `quality.py bump` on a PR.

ast-grep.reason: Pinned so an upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight (UPGRADE_DISCIPLINE.md). The scheduled scanner-bump workflow proposes the latest release as a PR.
ast-grep.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

skillspector.reason: Not published to PyPI; installed from its git tag. Pinned for the same reason as ast-grep.
skillspector.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

gitleaks.reason: A Go binary, not a Python package: installed from the release tarball, verified against the release's own checksum file. Pinned so an upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight (UPGRADE_DISCIPLINE.md). The scheduled scanner-bump workflow proposes the latest release as a PR.
gitleaks.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

ruff.reason: The security rules (S, the bandit set) of the linter the suite already runs. Pinned so an upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight (UPGRADE_DISCIPLINE.md). The scheduled scanner-bump workflow proposes the latest release as a PR.
ruff.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

actionlint.reason: The PyPI wrapper ships the actionlint binary, so one pip call installs it. Pinned so an upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight (UPGRADE_DISCIPLINE.md). The scheduled scanner-bump workflow proposes the latest release as a PR.
actionlint.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

zizmor.reason: Run --offline: no token, no network, same answer every run. Pinned so an upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight (UPGRADE_DISCIPLINE.md). The scheduled scanner-bump workflow proposes the latest release as a PR.
zizmor.lifting: Lifted every week by the scanner-bump PR once its canary run is green.

skillspector.always_block_reason: Credential access, environment-secret harvesting and credential exfiltration are secrets-class findings, and a secrets finding is never report-only (TESTING_STANDARDS.md section 5).

actionlint.reason: actionlint reports definite workflow defects -- a workflow it rejects fails on its first run anyway -- not heuristics. Zero standing findings at adoption.

gitleaks.policy: Always blocking: a secrets finding is never report-only, and the credential is rotated, not deleted from the diff (TESTING_STANDARDS.md section 5). A false positive is suppressed by fingerprint in .gitleaksignore under a comment giving the reason and the date.
